title: Anthony’s Italian Mushroom Cream

ingredientGroups.title: Rigatoni (Optional pairing)
items: 1 lb grilled chicken breast, cut into 1–1½-inch pieces

ingredientGroups.title: Chicken friand (Optional pairing)
items: ¼ cup mushroom sauce for filling
¼ cup mushroom sauce per pastry, for serving

steps: Heat the oil over medium-low heat and caramelize the onion.
In a large pot, sauté the mushrooms with the balsamic vinegar until their liquid is released and reabsorbed.
Add the onion, garlic, chicken stock, Marsala and white wine. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15–20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the cream and bring to a gentle simmer until slightly thickened. Finish with Parmesan and butter.
Serve as a soup with minced parsley, or use with one of the following pairings.
Toss the grilled chicken, cooked rigatoni, basil and parsley with the mushroom cream sauce. Season with salt and pepper if needed.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Combine the shredded chicken, cheeses and ¼ cup mushroom sauce. Enclose the filling between pairs of puff pastry sheets, pinching or crimping the edges.
Brush the pastries with egg wash. Bake on a parchment-lined cookie sheet for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve with ¼ cup mushroom sauce per pastry.
reviewFlags: The source does not specify how to prepare or how much egg wash to use for the optional chicken friands.
headnote: A versatile mushroom cream for chicken or pasta. Review the egg wash for the optional chicken friands.
ingredientNotes: Double base Mushroom Cream recipe to use as a soup.
